रणबीर कपूर की फिल्म रामायण ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर मचा दिया है गदर!
नॉर्थ अमेरिका में इस फिल्म ने बॉलीवुड के इतिहास के सबसे बड़े प्रीव्यू रिकॉर्ड दर्ज किए हैं।
करण जौहर ने रणबीर कपूर और पूरी कास्ट की जमकर तारीफ की है।
रैपर बादशाह ने भी फिल्म देखकर इमोशनल होने की बात स्वीकार की है।
आलिया भट्ट ने बेटी राहा के साथ सेट्स से रणबीर की तस्वीरें शेयर की हैं।
क्या आपने अभी तक रामायण के ये रिकॉर्ड्स देखे हैं?

ctx.title: Box Office: Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana scripts history, records BIGGEST PREVIEWS of all time for Bollywood in North America
ctx.summary:
The first box office numbers for Ramayana Part One are in, and it's a record. The Ranbir Kapoor and Yash-starrer epic saga smashed the biggest previews of all time for Bollywood in North America. The movie grossed a whopping USD 2 million in its premiere at the North American box office. Of these, around USD 1.65 million came from the United States, while CAD 350K came from Canada.  
 This makes  Ramayana  the biggest Bollywood opener in the United States and the second biggest in Canada, trailing Dhurandhar: The Revenge. The  Ranbir Kapoor  starrer movie opened extremely well in Australia too, where it fetched around AUD 500K on the debut day. It is the fourth-biggest opening for a Hindi film in Australia, only behind  Dhurandhar 2 , Pathaan and Animal.  
 Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and Bankrolled by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana is set to smash many existing records and set new benchmarks. The initial reports are promising, suggesting a long run at the box office. Co-starring Sai Pallavi, Ravie Dubey, Arun Govil, Rakul Preet, Lara Dutta, and others, the epic saga is likely to see a massive surge in collections post the Laxmi Puja day (Diwali day) in its domestic markets. 
 Stay tuned to Pinkvilla for more updates.
